meta.name: ai-ml-governance
meta.description: Governs models and AI systems in production — intended use, evaluation, monitoring, human oversight, documentation, and the decision to deploy or retire. Use this before deploying a model or AI feature, when defining evaluation criteria, when a model's behavior has drifted, when assessing AI risk or regulatory exposure, or when deciding whether an AI system is fit for a consequential decision.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规范AI模型治理,把控上线风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你负责AI系统的合规与风险评估
copy.tagline_en: Govern AI models with clear oversight
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you own AI compliance and risk decisions

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会引导你按治理规范管理生产中的 AI 模型:先写明用途与边界,再制定评估、监控和人工复核规则,最后完成文档与退役预案。
howto.when: 当你要部署模型或 AI 功能、制定评估标准,或发现模型行为漂移等需要治理的情况时,会触发该流程。

say.text: 我要上线一个信贷审批模型,先帮我定义它的预期用途和不能用的场景。
say.note: Claude 会引导你写明用途、边界及影响对象。

say.text: 聊天机器人准确率下降了,帮我建立监控和漂移预警方案。
say.note: Claude 会安排输入分布监控和人工纠错率跟踪。

say.text: 请为客服自动回复系统设计人工审查与文档记录流程。
say.note: Claude 会提供监督机制与文档模板。

howto.what_en: After enabling, Claude guides you through governing AI models in production: specify what the system is and isn't for, set up evaluation, monitoring, and human review, then document and plan retirement.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you're about to deploy a model or AI feature, define evaluation criteria, or notice model drift — and in similar governance contexts.

say_en.text: I'm launching a credit model; define its intended use and exclusions.
say_en.note: Claude walks you through purpose, scope, and impacted people

say_en.text: My bot's accuracy dropped; help me set up monitoring and drift alerts.
say_en.note: Claude sets up monitoring and override tracking

say_en.text: Design human review and documentation for our customer-service bot.
say_en.note: Claude provides an oversight workflow and a doc template
